To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the addition of organic additives to chitosan-galatin composite films, can improve the properties of these films in order to be used as packaging materials in fatty food industry.
chitosan-gallic acid films are appropriate for fatty food packaging.

the release rate of GA from chitosan- and gelatin-based films is affected by the type of the additive used for its inclusion in the film, and the most appropriate additive for the release of the GA is ethanol.

the development of new biodegradable packaging films for fatty food.
the effect of organic additives and anti-oxidants on physiochemical and release properties of chitosan-galatin composite films.
the development of a new packaging material for fatty food.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of tween 20 at low concentration (0.1%), with ethanol and β-CD as well as physical mixture of GA- β- CD are the most appropriate candidates for fatty food packaging.
the chitosan- Gelatin composite films with GA could be appropriate candidates for fatty food packaging with different anti-oxidant demand.
the release rate of GA from the films to the fatty food simulant is strongly affected by the type of organic additives used for GA incorporation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, the release rate from film to fatty food simulants could be controlled with different methods of incorporation and organic additives.
chitosan- Gelatin films could be appropriate candidate to fatty food packaging and GA as an effective anti-oxidant can be released from these films to fatty food in appropriate time and rate.
the use of β-CD as a carrier for anti-oxidant in chitosan-geltain films is not appropriate.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of organic additives can be a useful tool to control release of anti-oxidants and physical and mechanical properties of the films.
the release rate from the films is dependent on the method of inclusion, the type of additive, and the fatty food simulant.
the addition of GA to the chitosan-geltain film can improve its antioxidant release to the fatty food simulant, but the physical and mechanical properties of the film will be affected.
